title: Links in a rendered markdown block have no hover or click
body:
A `markdown` fence draws as rendered markdown through `markdown_view` in `ui.rs` (e30fb15). Links inside it get their link style but no hover popup and no click. Their link numbers come from a separate `cmr::parse` of the block's lines, so they clash with the numbers of the agent message the block sits in.

## Proposal

`markdown_view` records its links under a key of their own, such as the entry, the block and the link's index within the block, and the hover and click code looks them up there.
close_reason: Fixed in e617df2. `MarkdownView` keeps the runs of its links, found by a new `link_runs` that `block_rows` shares. A link's key is now `ui::LinkKey`, the entry, the rendered block that numbers it if any, and its number there.
